description: Agent dismisses user, provides no real help, user explicitly frustrated

messages.content: My package was marked as delivered 3 days ago but I never received it. Order #88712.
Our records show the package was delivered on Tuesday. Have you checked with your neighbors or your building's mail room?
Yes, I've checked everywhere. I need a replacement or a refund. This is a $200 item.
Since the tracking shows the package as delivered, we unfortunately cannot issue a refund or replacement. You may want to file a claim with the carrier or file a police report for stolen packages.
That's completely unacceptable. I paid $200 and received nothing. This is useless support.

I understand your frustration. Our policy is that once a package is marked as delivered, the responsibility shifts to the carrier. I'd recommend contacting FedEx directly to dispute the delivery status. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
